# Interior Design

Interior design: redesign a room in the style you want, from a photo of the room in your MegaScenes library or from a description. Living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, bathrooms and offices.

## What it does
Pick a photo of the room from your MegaScenes library and name the style, or just describe the room. Claude tells you the price and makes the new design, keeping the walls, windows and layout of your photo.

**How the files are made:** each room design is generated by an image model. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install interior-design@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Interior Design talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/interior-design/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each room design uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The room designs show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_interior_design_models` | Models for room designs with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_interior_design_cost` | Exact price of one room design before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_interior_design` | Starts one room design in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_interior_design` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `list_my_images` | Your uploads and images made here, to pick the one to start from. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "Redesign my latest MegaScenes room photo in Japandi style"
- "Design a cozy Scandinavian living room with a reading corner"
- "Turn my last kitchen photo into an industrial style kitchen"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the room design (the room photo you pick from your library, if any, and the style you describe) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
